payload.text: (hv, 2026-11-17, first-hand to vc in the live channel, read by 10:35Z on vc's date -u; hv's words quoted, the rest vc's) TWO RULINGS. The open issues were 0696, 0697 and 0698. hv started cc, ic and dc for it the same morning.
